Specifically, the inner loop should iterate from `i` to the end of the string, not from `i+1`. This is because substrings can start and end at the same index, resulting in single-character substrings. The specification also incorrectly uses a list to store substrings, which can be inefficient for checking uniqueness. A set should be used instead to automatically handle uniqueness. Additionally, the substring extraction should include the character at index `j`, so the correct substring should be `S[i:j+1]`.
